LOOK: The Quezon City Government has denied the United People’s Initiative’s (UPI) request for a permit to hold their rally at White Plains Avenue in Quezon City for a third day on Tuesday. 

“Several personalities who spoke on stage incited the participants of the activity… to the accomplishment of any acts of sedition, rebellion, or insurrection.” the letter read.   

This is a violation of the LGU and the UPI’s agreement in their previous permits. | @keithcINQ
